fix(ercot): ORDC additive adder sources the supply-cap dual, not the balance dual (part 2/3)

The post-solve additive RTORPA construction added the total-family
balance dual to the energy price. That is correct only while the RTOLCAP
supply-cap row is the binding reserve constraint (energy cancels out of
a sum-R cap). When the physical shared headroom binds instead - every
2023 scarcity hour once the coal net-summer derate is on - the balance
dual is already folded into the energy LMP by the shared-headroom
coupling (test_total_shortfall_prices_and_lifts_lmp documents this), so
re-adding it double-priced exactly the scarcity hours: 100% of adder>$10
hours had energy duals already >$200, and the energy-only top-quantile
price-duration curve matches the measured RT tail while the with-adder
curve overshoots it.

New flag ercot_ordc_cap_dual_adder (default off, keeper-reproducing):
source the adder from the reserve-supply-cap rows' own duals, the
exactly-uninternalized component in both regimes (LP duality:
lambda_balance = lambda_cap + mu_headroom, and only mu passes into the
energy dual). DispatchResult gains reserve_supply_cap_dual (n_tiers, T),
sign-flipped >= 0. Same published-ORDC construction, no new parameter,
no price fit. 2023 A/B (coal derate on): C3a +42.7% -> +31.3%, C3b
0.435 -> 0.260, C3c tail unchanged at 162h; dispatch and energy duals
byte-identical.
